key_provisions_or_claims: Article 3(3)(d) network protection applies to all internet-connected radio equipment.
Article 3(3)(e) privacy and data protection applies to internet-connected, childcare, toy and wearable radio equipment processing personal data.
Article 3(3)(f) fraud protection applies to internet-connected equipment enabling money or virtual currency transfers.
Medical devices, vehicles, aviation and road toll equipment are exempted where covered by other EU legislation.
Applies from 1 August 2024; presumption of conformity via harmonised standards.
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Regulation 2022/30 makes cybersecurity essential requirements of the Radio Equipment Directive (network protection, privacy, fraud) mandatory for internet-connected, childcare, toy and wearable radio equipment, with exemptions for medical devices, vehicles and aviation. It applies from 1 August 2024.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 supplementing Directive 2014/53/EU with regard to the application of the essential requirements referred to in Article 3(3), points (d), (e) and (f)
